name: Amy stumbles down the corridor
description: Amy moves through the corridor, her steps unsteady. She stumbles repeatedly, struggling to maintain her balance as she continues forward.
related_events: Amy stumbles down the corridor

name: Amy Ascends the Stairs
description: Amy walks through the lobby and continues up the stairs toward the upper floor, moving steadily through the building's interior.
related_events: Amy walks up the stairs after passing through the lobby

name: Amy Exits the Hotel Unsteadily
description: Amy comes down from her hotel room, moving unsteadily as she steps outside.
related_events: Amy leaves the hotel unsteadily

name: The Door Opens to a Frightened Girl
description: A door clicks open, the same one seen before in a sequence of earlier moments. It swings slowly inward to reveal a little girl standing in the doorway, her face pale, her eyes wide with fear.
related_events: Door is unlocked and opened to reveal a frightened little girl

name: Amy's Father Confronts the Noise
description: Amy's father stumbled out of a room at the far end of the corridor, half walking, half dragging himself forward. He wore a stained white tank top, his eyes glassy and unfocused. The sound reached him, and his expression shifted. He turned toward the source of the noise, his jaw tightening, and moved down the hall with heavy, deliberate steps.
related_events: Amy's father emerges from a room in distressed state
Amy's father reacts angrily to a noise

name: Man Pulls Kicking and Screaming Girl from Closet
description: The little girl kicks and screams as the man pulls her out of the closet. She resists fiercely, her cries filling the room, but he continues to drag her into the open.
related_events: Little girl kicks and screams in distress
Man pulls little girl out of closet

name: Amy Checks the Mailbox in Bucharest
description: A cab pulls up to a building in Bucharest. Amy steps out, opens her bag, and takes out an envelope. She looks at the name written on it—Marla Chen—then walks to the row of mailboxes and scans the names listed on them, holding the envelope close as she compares.
related_events: Amy arrives at the building in Bucharest
Amy retrieves the envelope from her bag
Amy compares envelope name to mailbox labels

name: Girl Struggles to Escape While Being Carried Down Hallway
description: The man carried the little girl down the hallway, her body slung under his arm. She kicked and twisted, scraping her hands against the walls and door frames, trying to slow or stop his progress. As they passed the end of the hall, her hand swept across a small table, striking a glass vase and sending it crashing to the floor.
related_events: Man carries struggling girl down hallway
Girl knocks over glass vase while resisting

name: Winter Holds Amy's Hand
description: Winter grips Amy's hand tightly, his voice calm but insistent as he speaks. He tells her that her hand is not a presence, but an absence—a place where something is missing. He says it has no solid form, no true reality, and that they are the same: not real, not here, not anything. As he speaks, Amy grows still, her breathing slow, her fingers faintly trembling in his grasp. Her eyes stay fixed on their hands, and she begins to echo his words, her voice barely above a whisper.
related_events: Winter describes Amy's hand as an absence
Amy falls under Winter's influence

name: Amy Boards the Train
description: The train rushes into the station at hyper-speed and halts instantly. The doors hiss open, and the tall, odd-looking Conductor steps forward to greet Amy. She pushes past him without a word and steps inside.
related_events: Train arrives at station at hyper-speed and stops instantly
Train doors hiss open
Oddlooking Conductor greets Amy
Amy pushes past the Conductor

name: Man Abducts Little Girl by Force
description: The man grabs the little girl, lifts her under his arm, and pulls her away. His hands move over her body in a violent and sexually suggestive way as she kicks and screams. He carries her out of sight, struggling all the while.
related_events: Man forcibly carries away little girl
Man's hands grope little girl during abduction

name: Amy's Fall and the Manager's Response
description: Amy rushes down the staircase and loses her footing, sliding down several steps before overbalancing and flipping onto her back, coming to rest on the landing halfway between floors. From the top of the stairs, the Manager looks down, shouts for her to stop, and curses at her in his native language, making no move to help or follow.
related_events: Amy slips and falls down the staircase
Manager shouts at Amy from the top of the stairs

name: Amy Follows Her Father in the Flashback
description: Amy finds herself in a corridor, watching her father. He glances down the hall, in her direction, but shows no sign of seeing her. Without a word, he turns and walks quickly away. Amy hesitates, then begins to follow him, moving after him despite her disbelief.
related_events: Amy enters flashback and observes her father
Father looks down corridor but fails to notice Amy
Father turns and storms off in opposite direction
Amy follows her father despite disbelief

name: Amy Arrives at the Sealed Building
description: A cab pulls up at the intersection of Poteilari and Minvara. Amy steps out, glances around at the run-down street, and begins walking. She passes a side door and continues toward a building whose doors and windows are sealed shut with cinder-blocks. She stops in front of it, looking at the blocked entrances.
related_events: Amy exits cab at intersection of Poteilari and Minvara
Amy approaches sealed building with cinder-blocked entrances

name: Amy Descends to the Basement Entrance
description: Amy approaches a building sealed with cinder-blocks over its doors and windows. Along the side, she finds a narrow stairway pressed against the wall, leading down to a basement entrance. She walks down the steps, which are littered with trash. A filthy mattress lies at the bottom. She reaches the base of the stairs and stands before the basement entrance.
related_events: Amy descends narrow, trash-littered stairway to basement entrance

name: Amy Wakes and Leaves Quietly
description: Amy's eyes flutter open. She lies still for a moment, taking in the unfamiliar room. The man beside her is asleep. Without making a sound, she slides off the mattress and rolls onto the floor. She checks herself—still dressed—and grabs a small tape recorder from the ground. She presses rewind, listens for a second, then sets it down. She picks up a half-empty pack of cigarettes and slips away.
related_events: Amy wakes up and assesses her surroundings
Amy quietly moves off the mattress

name: Amy Wakes and Takes the Tape Recorder
description: Amy's eyes flutter open. She lies still for a moment, adjusting to the dim light and unfamiliar room. Carefully, she slides off the mattress and lowers herself to the floor. Her hands move quickly to check her clothes—she's still dressed. She reaches for a small tape recorder on the ground, presses the rewind button, and listens briefly. Satisfied, she grabs a half-empty pack of cigarettes and leaves.
related_events: Amy checks her clothing and feels relief
Amy retrieves and rewinds a tape recorder

name: Amy Takes Cigarettes and Leaves
description: Amy picks up a half-empty pack of cigarettes from the floor. She turns and walks out of the room, closing the door quietly behind her.
related_events: Amy takes a pack of cigarettes and leaves

name: Charles Rescues Amy and Reasserts Control
description: Charles opens the door and steps into the room, speaking sarcastically. He asks if this is where they keep the cheaper whores. Amy, sitting slouched in a chair, glances up at him without expression. Charles tells her she’s lucky to have a boss like him, claiming he’s saved her once again. He says the authorities were considering sending her to a government asylum for observation, but through his efforts, he convinced them she was only irresponsible. Amy asks what they were going to charge her with. Charles ignores the question and tells her to come on. Slowly, wincing from bruises, Amy gets up and follows him.
related_events: Charles enters the room and addresses Amy
Amy reacts to Charles's voice with silent glance
Charles claims he has saved Amy again

name: Charles Rescues Amy from Institutionalization
description: Amy sits slumped in a chair, looking pale and worn. The door opens, and Charles enters, speaking sharply. He tells her they were planning to send her to a government asylum for observation, but he intervened. Through his negotiations, he convinced them to classify her only as irresponsible. Amy, showing little reaction, says she supposes he gets to travel. Charles reminds her she’s lucky to have him, then asks if she has her things. She nods. Slowly, wincing from bruises, she rises from the chair as he waits.
related_events: Charles reveals Amy was nearly sent to government asylum
Charles claims credit for downgrading Amy's classification

name: Amy Rises from the Chair
description: After Charles tells her to come on, Amy slowly gets up from the chair, moving carefully as she feels the pain from her bruises.
related_events: Amy slowly rises while feeling her bruises

name: Amy Examines the Locked Door
description: Amy approached the wooden door, which was secured with a heavy chain threaded through a hole and fastened with a padlock to a hasp bolted to the frame. She inspected the padlock, then tugged at the door, pulling it open as far as the chain allowed—only a few inches. Through the narrow gap, she peered into the darkness beyond, but could see nothing.
related_events: Amy inspects the padlock on the chained door
Amy tugs the door restrained by the chain
Amy peers into the darkness beyond the partially opened door

name: Move the mattress and remove the hasp
description: Amy steps aside from the mattress she was standing on and shoves it upward, clearing the space beneath. She reaches for the hasp bolted to the door frame, grabs it, and pulls. The bolts holding it in place are loose and slide free from the wall, allowing her to yank the hasp away. With the obstruction gone, she pulls the door open.
related_events: Amy steps aside from the mattress and shoves it up
Amy grabs the hasp and pulls it free from the wall

name: Amy Opens the Door and Enters the Corridor
description: After pulling the hasp free from the door frame, Amy tugs the door open. The heavy padlock and chain swing loose. Beyond the threshold, a narrow corridor stretches into darkness. She steps forward and enters the dim passageway.
related_events: Amy pulls the door open after removing the hasp
Amy enters the narrow corridor beyond the door

name: Amy Responds to a Child's Scream
description: Amy stands in the main corridor, the space stretching ahead of her. She turns back toward the common area, which is empty. Then she hears it—a faint, echoing scream from a little girl. The sound pulls her attention down the corridor. She turns and begins to walk toward it. As she moves, the walls around her grow paler, the color slowly leaching away. She looks down and sees blood draining from a wound on her body. She stumbles back, then turns again as the scream continues. Nearby, a door begins to bang and rattle, as if someone is trapped, fighting to get out.
related_events: Amy hears a little girl screaming in the corridor

name: Amy's Walk Down the Bleaching Corridor
description: Amy walks down a long, cold corridor. As she moves forward, the walls around her slowly turn white, losing all color until they are completely bleached. Beneath her, the blood that had seeped from her wound begins to recede from the floor, vanishing as if being pulled away. The air is still, but distant screams echo faintly, growing no closer. She continues forward, her steps uneven, as the corridor transforms around her.
related_events: Corridor walls gradually turn white as Amy walks
Blood drains from Amy's wound on the floor

name: Amy Hears the Door Rattling
description: After seeing the blood drain from her wound, Amy stumbles backward. A sharp, insistent banging and rattling erupts from a door nearby, as if someone inside is desperately trying to get out.
related_events: Amy stumbles back upon seeing the blood drain
Amy hears banging and rattling at a door

name: Charles Sharpens a Pencil and Calls Amy
description: Charles sits at his desk, twisting a pencil into a small plastic sharpener. He finishes one pencil, blows off the shavings, and begins another. As he works, he speaks into the phone. He asks Amy if he woke her up, then tells her she was supposed to call him. Amy replies that she didn’t sleep because she was working, and that she had planned to call him the next day. Charles says he started thinking, and after a pause, expresses concern about her safety, saying he doesn’t want her disappearance or death to be his fault. Amy watches a puzzle box on her table, its surface briefly reflecting an image of a little girl screaming before fading. She tells Charles he’s off the hook, that she knew his message before he said it, and that she can’t come back until she knows the truth. She ends the call.
related_events: Charles sharpens a pencil at his desk
Charles confronts Amy about not calling

name: Charles Worries About Amy's Safety
description: Charles sits at his desk, sharpening a pencil. He tells Amy he was worried he woke her, but she replies that she doesn’t sleep while working. He reminds her she was supposed to call. She says she got caught up in her work and planned to call the next day. Charles says he started thinking, and Amy jokes that it’s never a good thing when he does. He admits he’s afraid her investigative methods might one day get her hurt or worse, and he doesn’t want to feel responsible if something happens to her. Amy looks at the puzzle box on the table, noticing an abstract image of a little girl screaming reflected in it, though the TV nearby shows only static. The image fades as she watches. She tells Charles he doesn’t have to worry—she’ll make sure nothing happens that would be his fault. Charles says she’s messing with his conscience. Amy responds that she can’t do emotional conversations, but she understands his message. She says she knew it was coming and asks if he wants her to come home. She tells him she can’t—not until she finds the truth. Then she says he’s off the hook and hangs up.
related_events: Charles expresses fear about Amy's safety and moral responsibility
Charles expresses unease about Amy's investigative methods

name: Amy Sees Image in Puzzle Box and Rejects Charles's Warning
description: Amy looks at the puzzle box on the table and sees an abstract image of a little girl screaming, different from the white static snow on the TV screen. She studies it closely, then watches as the image slowly fades. Charles expresses concern, warning her that some things should not be pursued and that he doesn’t want her harm to be on his conscience. Amy interrupts, telling him she can’t do the sensitive thing, that she already knows his message, and that she won’t stop until she uncovers the truth. She ends the conversation and remains focused on her task.
related_events: Amy notices an abstract image in the puzzle box
Amy dismisses Charles's emotional appeal and reaffirms her commitment to the truth

name: Amy Breaks Through the Doors and Starts Down the Stairs
description: Amy bursts through the building doors and steps down two of the ten stairs leading to the sidewalk. She moves quickly, her feet striking the concrete as people pass by on the street. A police car turns onto the road ahead. Amy stops, looks away, and begins walking calmly. The car speeds past. She starts walking faster, then breaks into a run.
related_events: Amy breaks through the building doors and descends two stairs

name: Amy Sees a Police Car Turn Onto the Street
description: Amy breaks through the doors of the building and steps onto the stairs. She descends two of the ten steps toward the sidewalk. People walking by hardly notice her. Ahead, a police car turns down the street. Amy stops, then walks calmly, turning her eyes away. The police car speeds past. Once it has passed, Amy begins walking faster, then starts to run.
related_events: Amy notices a police car turning onto the street

name: Amy Avoids the Police Car
description: Amy breaks through the doors of the building and steps down two of the ten stairs leading to the sidewalk. People walking by hardly notice. Ahead, a police car turns onto the street. She stops, looks away, and walks calmly as the car passes. Once it has gone, she begins walking faster, then starts to run.
related_events: Amy stops and averts her eyes to avoid attention

name: Amy Runs After the Police Car Passes
description: Amy stands on the sidewalk as a police car speeds past. She begins walking faster, her pace quickening with each step. Within seconds, she breaks into a run and moves swiftly down the street.
related_events: Police car races past Amy on the street
Amy increases her pace and begins running

name: Amy is struck and discovers black liquid on her back
description: In the dim darkness of the room, Amy lies motionless on her bed, face down, the sheet fallen away from her body. She is wearing only her panties. Suddenly, a wet thud echoes through the silence, and her body jerks slightly from the impact. Her eyes open, but she shows no fear. She glances around groggily, sees nothing, and closes her eyes again. A moment later, a thin trail of black liquid begins to seep from the center of her back, sliding slowly down her spine. It veers toward one shoulder blade, then runs along the edge of her neck, dripping onto the pillow beneath her head. She shifts, feeling the wetness, and lifts a hand to her shoulder, smearing the dark substance across her fingers. Still drowsy, she rubs at it as if brushing away a speck, but more liquid continues to flow. Her eyes open fully. She sits up with effort, looks at her stained hands, then reaches behind her shoulder and pulls back a hand slick with the same black fluid. She stares at it, then at the darkened pillow. Slowly, she rises, moves unsteadily to her feet, and walks toward the bathroom, leaving damp, dark footprints behind her on the floor.
related_events: Unseen object strikes Amy in the dark
Black liquid begins oozing from Amy's back
Amy attempts to brush off the substance while half-asleep

name: Amy Discovers the Black Liquid on Her Body and Pillow
description: Amy sits up in bed, wincing in pain. She looks at her hands and sees they are stained with a sticky black liquid. She reaches over her shoulder to touch her back and pulls her hand away, now smeared with the same dark substance. She glances down at the pillow beside her and sees it is also stained with the liquid, spreading in irregular patches across the fabric.
related_events: Amy wakes up and notices black liquid on her hands
Amy touches her back and finds more black liquid
Amy observes black liquid stains on her pillow

name: Amy Walks to the Bathroom Leaving Black Footprints
description: Amy pushed herself up from the bed with difficulty, her movements slow and unsteady. She took uneven steps across the floor toward the bathroom, each foot leaving a damp, dark smear behind. The black liquid continued to seep from her back, trailing down her skin and dripping onto the ground with each step.
related_events: Amy struggles to stand and walks toward the bathroom

name: Amy Flees the Man Eating Crickets
description: Amy rounds a corner into a narrow street, her footsteps echoing sharply. A ragged man leans against the wall of a building, motionless at first. As she draws closer, he stirs, plucking crickets from the wall and crunching them one by one. He turns to her, stares blankly, then offers her a live cricket with a smile. Amy jerks backward, spins around, and runs. She sprints down the street, putting distance between herself and the man.
related_events: Amy encounters a ragged man eating crickets off a wall
Homeless man offers Amy a live cricket
Amy reacts with fear and flees the scene

name: Amy Investigates the Subway Grate
description: After fleeing down the narrow street, Amy notices a flicker of light and a faint noise coming from a subway grate in the pavement. She scrambles toward it and throws herself down on the grate. Through the metal, she sees indirect, flickering light rising from below and hears the roar of a subway train passing deep in the tunnel.
related_events: Amy notices flickering light and distant noise from a subway grate
Amy scrambles toward the source of the light and throws herself down on the subway grate
Amy sees indirect flickering light rising from the subway tunnel
Amy hears the roar of a subway train passing beneath the grate

name: Amy Approaches the Subway Entrance
description: After seeing the light and hearing the noise rising from the subway grate, Amy looks up and spots a nearby subway entrance. She gets to her feet and hurries toward it.
related_events: Amy looks up and discovers a nearby subway entrance
Amy hurries toward the subway entrance

name: Amy Investigates the Door with Flies
description: Amy moves down a narrow, dark hallway and stops at a door. She knocks, but there is no answer. She notices a fly crawling out from under the door, then another, and another. Kneeling, she leans close and sniffs the air near the bottom of the door. The smell is strong and foul. She lies down, presses her nose close to the gap, and inhales. The stench of rot fills her nose. A worn shoe appears in front of her. She jumps up to face the Manager, who watches her with irritation, a half-smoked cigar clenched in his yellowed teeth.
related_events: Amy knocks on the door in the dark hallway
Flies emerge from under the door
Amy inspects the door's base and smells the air

name: Amy Confronts the Manager to Enter Marla's Room
description: Amy stands in the narrow hallway, watching flies crawl from under a door. She kneels and presses her nose close to the gap, breathing in the foul air. A worn shoe appears before her. She looks up to see the Manager, an older man with a cigar clenched between his yellowed teeth, smoke curling from his nostrils. He asks if she’s lost something. Amy hesitates, then says she’s looking for her half sister, Marla Chen. The Manager eyes her skeptically. 'You're not Chinese,' he says. 'She's my half sister,' Amy replies. 'Same mom, different dads. I haven’t heard from her in two weeks.' The Manager doesn’t respond. Amy sniffs the air again and asks if the smell is normal. He shrugs, unimpressed. 'Marla is a friend of mine,' she says. 'She’s missing.' She pulls out a few American bills and holds them out. The Manager stares at the money, then at her. He bites down on his cigar, takes the cash, and pulls a ring of keys from his pocket. The lock clicks open. Amy steps inside. The room is dark, cold, silent. Behind her, the Manager closes the door and taps his watch. She nods. He remains in the hallway as she moves forward, the buzzing of flies growing louder, the stench thick in the air.
related_events: Manager confronts Amy at the door
Amy claims to be searching for her half sister Marla Chen
Amy offers money to enter the room
Manager accepts bribe and unlocks the door

name: Amy Enters the Room and Endures the Stench
description: Amy steps into the dark, cold room as the Manager closes the door behind her. He taps his watch, then disappears down the hallway. She moves forward, the buzzing of flies growing louder. The stench hits her, thick and rotten, and she recoils, clutching her face. She forces herself to breathe, first in small, cautious sniffs, then in deeper, steadier breaths, fighting the urge to vomit as she adjusts to the foul air.
related_events: Amy enters the dark and cold room
Manager taps his watch and closes the door
Amy descends the dark hallway and reacts to the stench
Amy acclimates to the deathly ripe air through controlled breathing

name: Amy Takes Charles's Late-Night Call
description: The phone rings, and Amy quickly picks it up. 'Hello,' she says. Charles's voice comes through the line. 'Amy, it's Charles. I know it's not too late.' She replies, 'You just can't go too long without hearing my voice.' He admits he’s guilty. He tells her he’s been thinking about the story—what happened—and suggests it might not be the right one for her. Amy picks up the puzzle box from the table and turns it over in her hands. She says she values his opinion, but if there’s a story she was born to write, this is it. Charles warns her it’s too dangerous for many reasons. She tells him that’s not like him. He agrees, saying he’ll hate himself in the morning. Amy says she’s just a little messed up, in a funk, but she’s fine—she just needs sleep. Charles says he thought he’d mention it, though he should’ve known better. It goes against his instincts. She tells him that’s what she loves about him and says she’ll call him tomorrow. After a pause, she asks if he knows the word 'demon' comes from the Greek word for knowledge. He says he’s heard that before. She replies, 'Well, I wish somebody had told me about it.' She hangs up and turns off a light as she heads to bed.

Amy shares a fact about the etymology of the word "demon"

description: The phone rings and Amy answers. Charles tells her it's late, but he couldn't wait. Amy jokes that he can't go long without hearing her voice. Charles admits it, then says he's been thinking about the story she's working on—he doesn't think it's right for her. Amy picks up the puzzle box from the table and turns it over in her hands. Charles agrees, and says he'll regret the call in the morning. Amy says she's just in a bad mood, that all she needs is sleep. Charles says he only wanted to see if she'd reconsider, and he should have known better. Amy tells him that's what she loves about him, and she'll call tomorrow. After a pause, she asks if he knows the word "demon" comes from the Greek word for knowledge. Charles says he's heard that before. Amy replies that she wishes someone had told her earlier. She hangs up and turns off a light as she heads to bed.
related_events: Charles expresses concern about Amy writing the story
Amy asserts her determination to write the story
Amy picks up and handles the puzzle box

name: Amy and Charles Share a Moment of Vulnerability

She tells him she’s just a little messed up in the head, says it’s only a temporary funk, and insists she’s fine, that all she needs is sleep. Charles admits he will regret his words
Charles expresses regret for bringing up a sensitive topic

name: Amy Ends Call and Prepares for Bed
description: Amy tells Charles that the word 'demon' comes from the Greek word for knowledge. Charles says he has heard that before. Amy replies that she wishes someone had told her about it. She hangs up the phone, turns off a light, and walks toward her bedroom.
related_events: Amy shares a fact about the etymology of the word "demon"
Amy hangs up the phone and turns off the light before going to bed

name: Inspect the Train and Question Amy
description: Transit cops and track workers spread out across the station, checking beneath the train and scanning the platform. A track worker emerges from under the car, shaking his head, and speaks with the driver, who curses and turns back toward the front of the train. One of the cops approaches Amy, who is leaning against a metal pillar near the empty bench. 'Well, the men have looked,' he says. Amy asks if they found anything. The cop notes she doesn’t seem surprised. As the train doors hiss shut and the train begins to pull away, the cop asks her again what she saw. Amy starts to describe standing on the platform, seeing a man at the edge, facing away. Through the windows of the moving train, she suddenly spots a figure on the far platform—the man in the black trench coat. She pushes off the pillar and sprints toward the stairs. The cop calls after her. Another cop, Tomislav, rushes to intercept. Amy shouts, pointing at the figure visible through the train cars. Tomislav tackles her to the ground. She struggles, yelling at him to get off. The other cops converge, pulling her arms back and cuffing her. The last car passes, revealing the far platform—empty. Amy stops fighting, staring across the tracks. Tomislav stands, panting, and circles a finger near his ear. The other cops nod.
related_events: Transit Cops and Track Workers inspect train and platform
Track Worker reports to train Driver
Transit Cop questions Amy about the mysterious figure

name: Amy Sees the Figure on the Far Platform
description: The train doors hissed shut and the train began to pull away from the station, moving along the center tracks. As it gained speed, Amy watched through the windows of the passing cars and saw the man in the black trench-coat standing alone on the far platform. He was facing her. She gasped and immediately ran down the platform toward the stairs that led to the other side, eyes locked on the figure. The cop called after her, but she didn't stop. The train continued forward, and through the windows, she could still see the man. Then the last car passed, and the platform beyond was empty. The man was gone. The cops converged on her, tackling her to the ground. She struggled beneath their weight, shouting, until the last car cleared the view and she saw the platform was deserted. She went still, staring across the tracks. The cop named Tomislav stood up, panting, and made a circular motion near his ear.
related_events: Train doors close and train departs station
Amy spots the man in the black trench-coat on the opposite platform

name: Amy Sees the Figure and Is Tackled by Tomislav
description: Amy spots a lone figure on the far platform through the windows of the moving train. She sprints down the platform toward the stairs that lead to the other side, shouting. A Transit Cop calls out, then yells for Tomislav. Another officer, Tomislav, rushes to intercept her. As she reaches the stairs, he tackles her to the ground. She struggles, shouting at him to get off, but more cops converge. They pull her arms back and handcuff her. She stops resisting and stares at the far platform. It is empty. Tomislav stands, panting, and makes a circular motion near his ear. The other officers nod.
related_events: Amy chases after the figure across the station
Transit Cop Tomislav tackles Amy after chase

name: Amy Subdued on the Platform
description: The last car of the train passed, revealing the far platform empty—no figure in the black trench coat, no Winter. Amy stopped struggling beneath the weight of the officers. The Transit Cops pulled her arms back and fastened the handcuffs. Tomislav stood, panting, and looked down at her. He turned to the other officers, circled his finger near his ear, and said in Romanian, "She's crazy." The Cops exchanged glances as Amy remained on the ground, silent, staring across the tracks at the vacant platform.
related_events: Amy realizes the figure and Winter are gone from the far platform
Amy is handcuffed by Transit Cops on the platform
Tomislav signals to fellow Cops that Amy is crazy

name: Winters Questions Amy After the Trance
description: Amy opens her eyes, lying on the mattress surrounded by the silent Deaders. Winters stands over her, watching closely. He asks what she saw. She says nothing. He presses her, asking what she is afraid of. She replies that she is not afraid of him. Winters insists she is afraid but won’t run, then repeats that he is not a monster. He tells her he will never hurt her and will never leave. He offers her a knife. She stares at it, then suddenly pushes herself away, telling him to get back. The Deaders close in around her, reaching out. Winters takes the Puzzle Box and places it on a makeshift altar at the head of the mattress. The Deaders begin to chant, their voices rising in unison. Winters tells her to lie down, promising it will only hurt for a second. She calls him crazy. The chanting continues. He tells her there will be no more pain, only pleasure. The Deaders grab at her. She resists, struggling to break free.
related_events: Amy emerges from trance surrounded by Deaders
Winters questions Amy about her vision and fear
Winters declares he is not a monster and promises Amy safety

name: Winters Offers the Knife
description: Winters holds out a knife to Amy, telling her to accept his gift, promising she will feel no more fear or pain. For a moment, she seems to consider it. Then, as if jolted awake, she shoves herself backward, away from him. The Deaders close in around her, reaching out, as Winters places the Puzzle Box on a makeshift altar at the head of the mattress.
related_events: Winters offers Amy a knife as a symbolic gift
Amy rejects Winters' offer by pulling away

name: Winters Begins the Ritual with the Puzzle Box
description: Winters places the puzzle box on a makeshift altar at the head of the mattress. The Deaders surround Amy and begin chanting in unison. Their voices rise together, repeating phrases about the unreality of skin, eyes, muscles, bones, and senses. The words fill the space around Amy as the chant continues, steady and rhythmic.
related_events: Winters places puzzle box on makeshift altar
Deaders begin chanting ritual phrases around Amy

name: Winters Attempts the Ritual on Amy
description: Winters tells Amy to lie down, assuring her the pain will last only a second. The Deaders close in and grab her as she begins to panic. Amy struggles against their grip, pushing them away and resisting as they try to hold her down.
related_events: Winters instructs Amy to lie down promising brief pain
Deaders physically grab Amy as she panics
Amy resists and fights off Deaders' grasp

name: Amy Navigates the Blocked Archway
description: Amy steps into the dimly lit basement hallway, her path partially illuminated by faint light from the street. Ahead, an archway is blocked by a large pile of rubble, preventing passage. She pauses to examine the obstruction, then turns away, choosing not to attempt clearing it. Instead, she moves forward, continuing her exploration down the hallway.
related_events: Amy enters dimly lit basement hallway
Amy encounters rubble blocking archway
Amy decides to explore hallway instead of clearing rubble

name: Amy Moves Through Dark Corridors and Checks for a Presence
description: Amy moves through a series of dark, foreboding corridors, her footsteps quiet against the floor. She stops suddenly, sensing someone behind her, and turns around. The hallway is empty. She waits, then continues forward, the silence pressing in around her.
related_events: Amy navigates through a series of ominous corridors
Amy senses presence and turns around to check
Amy confirms no one is behind her and continues forward

name: Amy Enters the Bathroom at the End of the Hallway
description: Amy walks down the dim hallway toward the only door left, its opening slightly ajar. She reaches it, places a hand on the wood, and pushes it open. The room beyond is a bathroom. She steps inside.
related_events: Amy approaches the half-open door at the end of the hallway
Amy pushes the door fully open
Amy discovers the room is a bathroom
Amy enters the bathroom

name: Amy Enters the Bathroom, Figure Appears in Hallway
description: Amy steps into the bathroom, the door swinging open under her hand. Behind her, in the darkened hallway, a shadowy figure emerges from the depths of the corridor, standing motionless in the gloom, unseen by Amy but clearly visible in the dim light.
related_events: A shadowy figure appears in the hallway behind Amy

name: Amy and the Puzzle Box
description: After hanging up the phone, Amy pauses, then reaches for the puzzle box on the table. She turns it in her hands, running her fingers along its edges. The box begins to shift, unlocking with a series of clicks and changing shape. A glow emerges from within. The table trembles, and the ice in her glass rattles. Behind her, in the darkness, a figure appears—Pinhead. Startled, Amy jerks back, knocking the box onto the table. It snaps shut, the light fades, and the figure vanishes.
related_events: Amy picks up the puzzle box and examines it
Puzzle box begins to unlock and change shape
Amy reacts to the transforming puzzle box and sets it down
Table trembles and ice rattles in glass

name: Amy Hears Marla's Warning Through the Phone
description: The phone rings suddenly. Amy startles, knocking the puzzle box with her hand, and it snaps shut. The light within the box fades, and Pinhead, standing in the darkness behind her, disappears into the shadows. Amy grabs the phone and hears a hoarse, gurgling sound—wet and choked—like someone drowning. Marla's voice emerges from the receiver, strained and desperate: 'Don't open...' The line goes dead. Amy shoves the phone away, her breath quickening. She sits still, staring at the puzzle box on the table. Snow flickers silently on the TV screen. After a moment, she stands and pulls her pants on.
related_events: Phone rings startling Amy
Amy knocks the puzzle box closed
Pinhead vanishes into the shadows
Amy hears a disturbing gurgling sound on the phone call
Marla's voice warns Amy through the phone
Amy reacts to the phone call by shoving the phone away and panicking

name: Amy's Phone Call with Charles Turns Sinister
description: Amy hangs up the phone after arguing with Charles, telling him he’s her editor, not her mother. She waits, then hears nothing on the line. She calls out, 'Hello? Hello?' A wet, gurgling sound comes through the receiver—the same choking noise she heard from Marla before. The line goes dead. Amy shoves the phone away, breathing fast, her eyes fixed on the puzzle box.
related_events: Amy argues with Charles over the phone and senses something wrong

name: Amy Prepares to Leave After the Phone Call
description: After the phone call ends, Amy sits still, breathing quickly, her eyes fixed on the puzzle box. The room is quiet except for the sound of snow on the TV. She stands, steps away from the table, and pulls her pants on.
related_events: Amy stands up and pulls her pants on after the phone call

name: Amy Watches Marla's Tape
description: Amy sits on the floor in front of the couch, wearing only a bra and panties, her pale skin marked with bruises and bandaged scrapes. She presses a dripping ice pack to her injuries and takes a drink from a bottle of gin. Her gaze shifts to the television and the VCR, where a tape labeled 'AMY' lies half-inserted. She lifts her foot, hesitates, then pushes the tape the rest of the way in with her toe. She picks up the remote and turns on the TV. The screen flickers to life, showing Marla seated in a chair, staring into the camera with tired, distant eyes.
related_events: Amy applies ice pack to bruises and drinks gin while sitting on the floor
Amy inserts tape labeled 'AMY' into the VCR using her toe
Amy turns on the television and begins playing the videotape

name: Marla's Final Message
description: On the videotape, Marla sits in a dimly lit room, her eyes tired and distant. She speaks directly to the camera, telling Amy she knew she would come, but it is already too late for her. She warns Amy not to open the puzzle box, saying that if she does, Winter wins. A loud pounding begins on her door. Winter calls her name from the other side. Marla leans forward urgently, telling Amy to go to Pletkow station at midnight, to step onto the last car at the south end of the platform, and to find a man named Joey who runs the show—someone who can lead her to them. She pleads with Amy to save them. The pounding grows louder. In a final whisper, she says, 'Those you trust the most—trust the least,' then reaches forward and turns off the camera. The screen goes black, then fills with static.
related_events: Marla delivers a warning message from a pre-recorded video
Marla receives urgent warning and delivers instructions to Amy via video message
Marla cuts off the video message with a final warning

name: Amy Faces the Puzzle Box
description: Amy removes the puzzle box from her satchel and stares at it. She sets the box on the table, her eyes fixed on it. 'Don't open it. Right,' she says quietly. The television screen flickers with static after the video ends. Amy sits still, looking at the box, then at the snow on the screen.
related_events: Amy removes the puzzle box from her satchel and stares at it
Amy places the puzzle box on the table and resists opening it
Amy stares at the television static after the video ends

name: Amy Answers the Phone
description: Amy sits on the floor, staring at the snow on the TV screen. The shrill ring of an old-style phone cuts through the silence. She leans forward, picks up the receiver, and brings it to her ear. 'Yeah...' she says, her voice low and flat.
related_events: Amy answers a ringing phone that interrupts her thoughts

name: Amy Confronts Marla in the Tunnel
description: Amy and Marla hurry through a twisting tunnel lined with pipes that drip water and vent steam, the walls lit by flickering blue light. Amy stops and turns to Marla, demanding to know what happened to her. Marla tells her she put her head through a noose and jumped, that she was cut down and revived by Winter, who breathed life back into her. She says everyone was happy, that it was like a celebration, but then her voice wavers. She begins to cry, yellowish tears running down her face. She compares her state to walking a tightrope, saying that for a while she was balanced, but then she realized how high up she was—and fell. She admits she tried to end it again, and that’s when Amy found her. Amy asks why she’s there, why she’s involved. Marla says it’s for the reward. The tunnel trembles as a train approaches from the distance. They stop. Marla turns Amy to face her. She says it’s not enough for someone else to harm you—you have to be willing to do it to yourself, to accept it fully, to give your soul without fear or doubt. She admits she failed at that. The train rounds the bend, roaring toward them. Amy turns toward the sound. Marla says fear is where you go to learn. Amy looks back, confused. Marla tells her there’s no turning back—only he can bring her back. The train bears down on them. Then Winter appears, arms open, shouting over the noise of the oncoming train: 'All roads lead home.'
related_events: Amy confronts Marla about her condition and purpose
Marla recounts her suicide attempt and revival
Marla breaks down while explaining her emotional struggle

name: Marla's Confession in the Tunnel
description: Amy and Marla hurry through a twisting tunnel lined with pipes that drip water and vent steam, the walls glowing with eerie blue light. Marla tells Amy she once hanged herself, was cut down, and revived by Winter. At first, people were happy, and she felt alive, but it didn’t last. She compares her state to a tightrope walker who suddenly realizes how high up they are—then falls. She tried to end her life again, and that’s when Amy found her. The tunnel shifts around them, narrowing as a distant rumble grows louder. Marla stops and turns to Amy, saying that for the transformation to be complete, someone must not only be harmed by others but must harm themselves—that is the moment of acceptance, the final step before giving one’s soul willingly. Amy asks why, but Marla admits she doesn’t know the full reason. She only knows Winter promises an eternal paradise of ultimate pleasure, but the true purpose remains hidden. She confesses she failed because she still feels fear and doubt. The train rounds the bend, roaring toward them. Marla says fear is where you go to learn, then repeats that there’s no turning back—only Winter can bring her back. Amy turns toward the oncoming train, then spins around as Winter appears, arms open, shouting over the noise: 'All roads lead home.'
related_events: Marla explains the necessity of self-inflicted pain for acceptance
Marla reveals the promise of eternal paradise with withheld purpose
Marla reflects on her failure to overcome fear and doubt

name: The Train in the Narrowing Tunnel
description: The tunnel trembles as a train approaches from the distance, its roar growing louder. The walls close in as the train rounds the bend, speeding toward them. Marla stands firm, telling Amy there is no turning back. Amy turns toward the sound of the train, then back to Marla, who says fear is where you go to learn. Before Amy can respond, Winter appears, arms open, shouting over the noise of the oncoming train.
related_events: Train approaches as the tunnel trembles
Tunnel narrows as train rounds the bend
Marla declares fear as a place of learning
Marla reaffirms there is no turning back for Amy
Amy reacts to the sound of the approaching train

name: Winter Appears as the Train Approaches
description: In the narrowing tunnel, Marla turns Amy to face her as the rumbling of an oncoming train grows louder. Steam hisses from the pipes above, and the walls tremble. Just as the train rounds the bend, roaring forward at full speed, Winter suddenly appears in front of Amy, arms wide open. Over the deafening noise, he shouts, 'All roads lead home,' as the train hurtles toward them.
related_events: Marla turns Amy toward her in the twisting tunnel
Winter appears with open arms as train roars in
Winter declares that all roads lead home

name: Amy Activates the Tape Recorder at the Party
description: Amy Klein moves through the crack/X party, her long black coat swaying as she reaches into the pocket and pulls out a tape recorder. She clicks it on and slips it back into her pocket, then continues through the dimly lit room, her eyes scanning the crowd as music and voices hum around her.
related_events: Amy Klein retrieves tape recorder from coat pocket

name: Amy Pretends to Take Crack at the Party
description: At a crack and X party the night before, a man offers Amy Klein a hit of crack. She lets him place it on her tongue and appears to swallow it, playing along as if under the influence. Moments later, she discreetly removes the drug from her mouth and flicks it away. She continues moving through the party, taking the crack pipe when it comes around but quickly passing it on, pretending to be too far gone for another hit. All the while, she watches the others closely, observing their behavior without actually using the drugs.
related_events: Man offers Amy Klein crack
Amy Klein fakes ingestion of crack

name: Amy Pretends to Use the Crack Pipe While Observing the Party
description: The crack pipe moves from hand to hand as the party grows more intense. Amy takes the pipe, brings it to her mouth, and pretends to inhale, then quickly passes it along. She lets her movements loosen, her eyes glaze over, playing the part of someone deep in the high. Around her, the others sway and mutter, lost in their own states. She watches them carefully, noting their behavior, staying alert beneath the act. The smoke thickens in the air, the music pulses, and she remains seated among them, appearing gone but seeing everything.
related_events: Crack pipe circulates among partygoers
Amy Klein pretends to use crack pipe

name: Amy Alone with the Man After the Party
description: After the party, only Amy and the man remain. He lies half-naked on the mattress and pulls her toward him, forcing her down. She resists, but her vision begins to blur, and the room starts to spin. As he tries to undress her, his eyes roll back and he collapses unconscious. Amy looks around, disoriented, then tips out of frame.
related_events: Man attempts to force Amy Klein onto mattress
Amy Klein experiences vision blurring and disorientation

name: Man Passes Out During Assault, Amy Collapses
description: The man pulls Amy onto the bed and begins undressing her. She tries to resist but cannot break free. Suddenly, his eyes roll back and he collapses, unconscious. Amy, her vision blurring and body failing, looks around the swaying room. She tips out of frame and falls.
related_events: Man passes out while attempting to undress Amy Klein
Amy Klein collapses out of frame

name: Amy Smashes Through Shower Door and Falls into Bathtub
description: Amy crashes backward through the safety-glass shower door, shattering it into countless fragments as she tumbles into the bathtub. Her head strikes the tile wall with a sharp impact, and she slides down into the dark, water already cascading over her face.
related_events: Amy smashes through the safety-glass door into the bathtub
Amy's head strikes the tile wall during the fall

name: Amy Activates Shower in the Dark
description: Disoriented and in the dark, Amy reaches out and grabs a metal handle inside the bathtub. As she pulls, water suddenly begins to cascade down onto her face. She turns sideways, rolling over and gasping as the water hits her.
related_events: Water begins cascading onto Amy after she pulls a handle

name: Crawling Through Broken Glass
description: Amy crawls over the broken edge of the shattered glass door, her skin catching on the jagged remnants of glass still embedded along the frame. She pulls herself out of the shower area, dragging her body across the wet tiles as she struggles to stand.
related_events: Amy crawls out of the broken shower enclosure

name: Amy Finds the Light and Sees Herself
description: Amy crawls across the broken glass still clinging to the edge of the shattered shower door, pulling herself up by the sink. Her fingers grope along the wall until they find the light switch. She flips it on. The bathroom fills with light. She slumps against the sink, soaked, her skin scratched, her body trembling. She stares into the mirror. A small square of glass is embedded in her shoulder. She pulls it out and drops it into the sink, where it makes a faint clink. Water streams down her face. She turns toward the bathtub, reaches through the broken door, and turns off the shower.
related_events: Amy turns on the bathroom light and sees herself in the mirror

name: Amy Removes Glass from Shoulder
description: Amy notices a small square of glass embedded in her shoulder. She reaches up, pulls it free, and drops it into the sink. The shard makes a faint clink as it lands among the porcelain fragments.
related_events: Amy removes a piece of glass from her shoulder

name: Amy Pauses, Realizing the Situation
description: Amy lifts her hand to wipe the wet hair from her face, but stops mid-motion. She turns her gaze toward the bathtub, then reaches through the shattered glass door and turns off the shower.
related_events: Amy pauses while lifting her hand to wipe wet hair from her face

name: Amy Turns Off the Shower
description: Amy turns toward the bathtub, reaches through the shattered glass door, and turns off the shower.
related_events: Amy turns toward the bathtub and reaches through the shattered door to turn off the shower

name: Amy Forces Through a Stuck Turnstile
description: Amy comes down the stairs into the dim, unattended metro entrance. The fluorescent lights flicker, some dark. She fumbles for her metro card and steps toward the turnstile. As she pushes through, the turnstile squeaks and jams, trapping her halfway. She tries to step back, but the mechanism won't release. She leans forward and heaves, forcing the turnstile to give way. As she stumbles through, she leaves behind a trail of bloody footprints. Standing in a growing pool of her own blood, she notices a stack of newspapers on a nearby stand. She grabs one and throws it over the blood, but it soaks through immediately. She throws down another, then a third, but the blood seeps out from under them all. Footsteps echo down the corridor. Through a mirror at the intersection, she sees a cop approaching, his baton tapping against his leg. As he nears, she grabs the newspaper stand and tips it over with a loud SMASH, scattering papers across the floor. The cop walks past, the blood now hidden beneath the scattered newspapers. Amy crouches down as if cleaning up the mess. She makes eye contact with the cop, shrugs, and he responds with a smile and a nod before continuing on. The sound of his footsteps fades. Amy takes a few deep breaths and walks toward the platform.
related_events: Amy becomes trapped in a malfunctioning turnstile
Amy forces her way through the stuck turnstile

name: Amy Finds Herself Bleeding
description: After forcing her way through the stuck turnstile, Amy sees bloody footprints trailing behind her. She looks down and finds herself standing in a pool of blood, dark and spreading beneath her feet.
related_events: Amy discovers she is injured and leaving bloody footprints
Amy observes herself standing in a pool of her own blood

name: Amy Sees the Cop and Hides the Blood
description: Amy hears footsteps echoing toward her. Through a large mirror at an intersection, she sees a police officer on patrol approaching. She looks down and sees she is standing in a pool of her own blood. She grabs a stack of newspapers from a nearby stand and throws one down to cover the blood, but it soaks through quickly. She throws down another, then another, but the blood continues to seep up from beneath. The officer rounds the corner, tapping his baton against his leg. Amy grabs the newspaper stand and tips it over with a loud SMASH, spilling papers across the floor. As the officer walks past, the blood is hidden under the scattered newspapers. Amy bends down as if tending to the mess. She makes eye contact with the officer and shrugs. The officer smiles, nods, and continues on. His footsteps fade down the corridor. Amy takes a few deep breaths and moves toward the platform.
related_events: Amy notices a police officer approaching

name: Amy Hides Her Blood Trail from a Passing Cop
description: Amy moves through a turnstile and finds herself stuck, emerging with a bleeding foot that leaves a trail behind her. She notices the blood and quickly grabs a newspaper from a nearby stand, throwing it over the pool. The blood soaks through immediately. She adds more newspapers, one after another, but the stain spreads beneath them. Footsteps approach. A police officer rounds the corner, tapping his baton against his leg. In one motion, Amy knocks over the entire newspaper stand, scattering papers across the floor and concealing the blood. She crouches down as if cleaning up a simple accident. The officer glances at her, nods, and continues on his way. Once the footsteps fade, Amy stands and walks toward the platform.
related_events: Amy uses newspapers to cover her bloody footprints
Amy overturns the newspaper stand to hide the blood

name: Amy Feigns Innocence to Evade the Officer
description: Amy bent down as if to gather the scattered newspapers. She looked up just as the officer approached, meeting his gaze. She shrugged her shoulders, her hands open in a gesture of apology. The officer glanced at the mess, smiled slightly, and nodded before continuing on his way, his footsteps fading into the distance.
related_events: Amy pretends to clean up the spilled newspapers
Amy exchanges a shrug with the police officer
Police officer walks past Amy without suspicion

name: Amy Collects Herself After the Encounter
description: After the officer's footsteps fade down the corridor, Amy stands still and takes several deep breaths. She straightens up, looks around, and then continues walking toward the metro platform.
related_events: Amy regains composure after evading detection

name: Walking in the Rain with the Truth
description: Charles and Amy walk side by side under a shared umbrella as rain pours heavily around them. Charles asks Amy why she took on the story, suggesting no one else would have. Amy insists it's real, though she admits she might be crazy. Charles accepts her answer, noting that either way, it makes for a good story. Amy says she has new leads and will know the truth soon. They continue walking, the weight of her investigation hanging in the air between them.
related_events: Charles and Amy walk together under shared umbrella during heavy rain
Amy affirms the reality of her story despite potential disbelief
Amy reveals her ongoing investigation with new leads

name: Charles and Amy in the Rain
description: Charles and Amy walk together under an umbrella as rain pours down. Charles asks Amy why she took the story, saying no one else would have—either they’d think it was lies or be too afraid. He tells her that most people only want to know enough to satisfy their curiosity, but she’s different, like someone who can’t stop eating. Amy replies that she doesn’t see him complaining. Charles says that’s the point—he needs her. He sends her to uncover the things he wants to know but doesn’t want to face himself. Amy says it’s her choice, and Charles agrees, saying no one’s forcing her. He admits he lies awake at night worrying about God, heaven, and hell, and wants to know what’s real so he can make sense of things. He urges her to find out and bring the truth back. Amy says he seems vaguely demonic. Charles responds that the word 'demon' comes from the Greek word for 'knowledge.' He calls for a cab, tells her to go rest in her room until daylight, then get him his story. She assures him he doesn’t need to worry. He says he never does—he doesn’t save or judge people, he just uses them as they pass. He gets in the cab and leaves. Amy watches, waves, then turns and flags down another cab, getting in and driving away.
related_events: Charles compares Amy's curiosity to gluttony
Charles explains his reliance on Amy's pursuit of forbidden knowledge

name: Charles Confesses His Fears and Sends Amy on a Mission
description: Charles and Amy walk together under an umbrella in the heavy rain. Charles tells Amy that no one else would have taken her story—either people would dismiss it as nonsense or be too afraid to face it. He says she’s different, calling her a glutton for knowledge, someone who keeps consuming even when others would stop. He admits he doesn’t want to face these things himself, but he needs her to do it for him, so he can know without suffering the consequences. Amy says she’s not being forced, and Charles agrees. He reveals that he lies awake at three in the morning, haunted by thoughts of God, heaven, and hell—questions that matter to him when it comes to making sense of his life. He tells her to find out the truth about what lies beyond. As they reach Amy’s hotel, Charles flags down a cab, tells her to rest until daylight, then go get him his story. Amy assures him she’ll take care of it. Charles says he never worries, that he doesn’t judge or save people—he just uses them as they pass. He gets in the cab and leaves. Amy watches him go, waves, then turns and flags down another cab for herself.
related_events: Charles confesses his existential fears about religion and the afterlife

name: Charles Shares the Etymology of 'Demon'
description: Amy tells Charles there's something vaguely demonic about him. Charles replies that the word 'demon' comes from the Greek word for 'knowledge,' as in 'demonstrate.' Amy says she didn't know that. Charles shakes his head, disgusted, and mutters, 'American education.'
related_events: Charles shares etymological origin of the word 'demon' with Amy
Charles expresses disdain for American education

name: Parting at the Hotel in the Rain
description: Charles and Amy stand under the umbrella in front of Amy's hotel, rain falling heavily around them. Charles raises his hand and signals a passing cab. He tells Amy to go back to her room, rest, and then continue working on the story before saying he’ll be waiting at the Soffitel. He gets into the cab and drives away. Amy watches the car recede into the downpour, lifts her hand in a small wave, then turns toward the curb. She raises her arm, flags down another cab, and climbs in. The cab pulls away, carrying her into the rainy night.
related_events: Charles hails a cab and departs for the Soffitel
Amy flags down a cab and departs after watching Charles leave

name: Amy Approaches the Figure in the Green Raincoat
description: After the train departs, Amy checks her watch and moves to the other side of the platform. She sees the light of an approaching train reflecting in the tunnel. Far down the platform, a still figure sits slumped on a bench, wearing a shiny green raincoat. Amy walks closer, trying to see more. As she nears, she notices a gray hand dangling limply from the edge of the bench. Beneath the raincoat, a small pool of fresh blood begins to form. She takes another step forward. Suddenly, the figure’s eyes snap open—large, black, and lifeless. Amy gasps and stumbles back.

name: Amy Stumbles After Seeing the Man in the Green Raincoat
description: The man in the shiny green raincoat sat slumped on the bench, motionless. As Amy approached, she noticed his hand dangling over the edge of the bench, gray and lifeless. A dark pool of blood spread slowly from beneath his coat. Suddenly, his eyes snapped open—wide, black, and empty. Amy gasped, recoiling in shock. She stepped back, her heel catching the edge of the platform. She wobbled, arms flailing, struggling to keep her balance as she nearly fell.
related_events: Man in green raincoat suddenly opens his eyes
Amy discovers blood pooling beneath the man in the raincoat
Amy gasps and loses balance at the platform edge

name: Winter Confronts Amy and Steps in Front of the Train
description: Amy stands on the platform as the train pulls away. She checks her watch and moves to the other side, looking down the tunnel. A light reflects off the curved wall as another train approaches. Far down the platform, a figure slumps on a bench, wearing a shiny green raincoat. Amy walks toward it, stepping closer to the edge for a better view. One hand hangs limp from the bench, gray and lifeless. She takes another step forward when suddenly a voice calls out. Winter stands twenty feet behind her, dressed in a black trench coat, his back to the tracks. He says, 'Amy Klein!' She turns. He stares at her with dark, malevolent eyes. The train rushes into the station. Without breaking eye contact, Winter tilts backward and falls directly into the path of the oncoming train. Amy screams, scrambling to her feet, running alongside the braking train. The doors open, but no one exits. She reaches the front of the train and pounds on the window. The driver, a middle-aged woman, leans out. 'Somebody fell,' Amy shouts. 'Back there—someone fell in front of the train!' The driver asks where. Amy turns to point, but the bench is now empty. The doors hiss shut. No one else reacts. Winter is gone.
related_events: Winter appears on the platform and calls out to Amy
Winter stares at Amy with malevolent eyes
Winter falls backward into the path of the oncoming train

name: Amy Runs Alongside the Train and Reports a Man on the Tracks
description: Amy screamed as the train rushed into the station. She scrambled to her feet and ran alongside the braking cars, her footsteps echoing against the platform. Reaching the front of the train, she pounded on the window until it slid open, revealing the train driver, a middle-aged woman. 'Somebody fell,' Amy gasped. 'Someone fell in front of the train!' The driver frowned. 'Where? Where'd he fall?' Amy turned and pointed back down the platform. 'Back there, way back.' The driver cursed under her breath. Amy looked around, scanning the faces in the train doors and the empty bench, but there was no sign of Winter.
related_events: Amy screams and runs alongside the braking train
Amy alerts the train driver about the person hit
Train driver responds with frustration upon hearing the report

name: Amy Searches the Platform and Train After the Incident
description: After reporting the man who fell in front of the train, Amy moves quickly along the platform, scanning the faces of the passengers stepping off the train. She looks back toward the bench where the figure in the green raincoat had been, but it is now empty. She checks each doorway and window of the train, searching for any sign of Winter or the slumped man, but no one reacts or appears to have witnessed anything. The train driver leans out, frustrated, asking where the person had fallen. Amy turns in confusion, looking from the platform to the train, but finds no trace of either man.
related_events: Amy searches for Winter among the passengers and platform
Amy notices the bench is now empty
Train driver responds with frustration upon hearing the report

name: Amy enters the subway station and descends to the platform
description: Amy swipes her card through the slot and pushes through the turnstile. She walks down a long escalator that is not working, her footsteps echoing in the quiet. She reaches the subway platform below, the space lit by cold fluorescent light and nearly empty at this hour.
related_events: Amy enters subway station using access card
Amy descends non-working escalator to platform

name: Amy Notices the Vanished Figure and Takes Position at the Platform's End
description: Amy reached the empty subway platform and scanned the far end, where a motionless figure in a shiny green plastic raincoat lay on a bench. A moment later, she saw that the figure was gone. She moved to the far end of the platform and took her place there, standing near the stenciled Puzzle Box as the air stirred with the approach of the train.
related_events: Amy observes motionless figure in green raincoat on bench
Amy notices disappearance of figure in green raincoat
Amy positions herself at far end of subway platform

The girl stares at Amy’s face, her hand moving across the paper with steady, deliberate strokes unlike those of a child. The portrait shows Amy’s face twisted into a grotesque form—her skin stretched, her eyes dark and hollow, a jagged wound torn open in her chest with hooks pulling the flesh aside. Each image shows a person morphed into a monstrous figure—faces stretched into unnatural shapes, bodies warped, eyes dark and empty. name: Charles Greets Amy by Scent and She Tells Him to Eat Her
description: In his office, Charles Rickman stands with his back to the door, fiddling with a TV/VCR setup. As the door opens, he speaks without turning, remarking on the arrival of a familiar scent—female sweat and patchouli oil. He turns and sees Amy Klein standing there, greeting her as 'angel of light' and gesturing to a seat. Amy responds flatly, 'Eat me, Charles,' and remains standing.

name: Amy and Charles Exchange Barbs Over Past Reassignments
description: Charles turns from the TV/VCR setup as Amy enters his office. He mocks her arrival with a comment about her scent, calling her the 'delightful and world-famous Amy Klein' and tells her to have a seat. Amy responds with 'Eat me, Charles.' He reminds her that her lack of respect got her fired from the New York Post. Amy corrects him, saying she wasn’t fired, only re-assigned. Charles says he doesn’t recall ever being properly thanked for taking her on, making air quotes around 're-assignment.' He adds that he opened his doors as soon as he heard she was 'available,' again using air quotes. Amy walks over to a trophy table and picks up a framed photo of herself and Charles, both smiling. She points to it and says she recalls a similar reassignment in his past. Charles replies, 'Touche.' He then remarks that thanks to international conglomerates and the Euro-dollar, he and Mother England are once again blessed with her presence. Amy says a contract is a contract and holds up her cassette recorder.

name: Amy Brings Tape, Charles Shows the Videotape
description: Amy holds up a cassette recorder, offering it to Charles as she stands in his office. He cuts her off before she can explain its contents. On his desk, an open container of Chinese food sits untouched until Amy picks it up, takes a bite, and sets it down again. Charles gestures for her to sit and tells her he has something to show. He moves to a TV and VCR setup, fiddling with the machine until he finds the right spot on a worn videotape. He explains it arrived anonymously, with no return address or note. He asks if she’s ever heard of a group called the 'Deaders.' Amy pauses, then asks if he means 'Deadheads,' launching into a description of Grateful Dead fans and their habits. Charles waves her off, uninterested. She shrugs and says she doesn’t know what he’s talking about. He insists she watch the tape, gets up, and closes the office door. Amy tosses the food container into the trash, pulls out a cigarette, lights it, and sits back down. Charles presses play. The screen flickers to life.

name: Amy and Charles Watch the Deaders' Initiation Tape
description: Charles turns on the videotape and the screen fills with shaky footage of a dimly lit apartment. A group of people gathers around a mattress on the floor. Marla Chen holds a handheld camera, briefly recording her reflection in a smudged mirror before turning it toward the others. She announces Katya’s arrival and points the camera at her. Winter steps forward, raising a hand for silence. Katya stands motionless as Marla identifies another figure, Anna, on camera. Katya begins reciting a statement declaring herself unreal. Winter places a handgun into her hand and presses it to her head. Other hands reach into frame—someone presses a folded towel against the side of Katya’s head, then a doubled-over pillow against the towel. Winter cocks the gun. Katya pulls the trigger. The force of the shot throws her sideways, blood and tissue splattering the mattress and nearby wall. The camera lingers on the aftermath. In Charles’s office, Amy stares at the screen, her cigarette falling from her fingers. She steps back, voice sharp with alarm, demanding to know if the police have been called. Charles tells her to keep watching.

name: Winter Revives Katya in Ritual Resurrection
description: Winter kneels beside Katya's body and gently removes the gun from her hand. She lies down on top of Katya, pressing her forehead against Katya's before beginning a long, deliberate breathing ritual, mouth to mouth. After several strained attempts, Katya's body suddenly twitches. A ragged breath escapes her lips. Her eyes move beneath closed lids, and her head lifts slightly. Winter looks down, her face weary, and smiles. She slides off Katya and reaches to help her sit up. Katya touches the wound on her head, her fingers pressing into the damaged skull. She pulls her hand away, stares at the blood, and then laughs—softly at first, then with growing disbelief. 'I'm fine,' she says. 'I feel great.' The others gather around, touching her arms, embracing her, murmuring in awe. Marla pushes forward, straining for a closer look.

name: Amy Witnesses Winter's Ritual Over Katya's Corpse
description: Amy stands frozen in the dim light, watching as Winter kneels beside Katya's lifeless body. Winter lowers herself onto Katya, pressing their mouths together, breathing into her as if passing something vital. Her movements are slow, deliberate, almost tender, yet utterly out of place in the silence of death. Amy does not move or speak, her eyes fixed on the scene. She grips the wall beside her, her breath shallow. Winter continues, unmindful of observation, repeating the act again and again, her body rising and falling above Katya's still form. Amy watches, unable to look away.

name: Amy and Charles After the Tape Ends
description: The videotape cuts abruptly to static, the screen silent and blank. Amy and Charles sit in stillness, staring at the monitor. Charles leans forward, frowning. He wonders aloud if the footage is real or a hoax. He turns to Amy, suggesting she look into it. Amy doesn't answer right away. Her hand rises slowly to the side of her head, her fingers brushing the spot where a wound once was, mirroring a gesture she just saw. Charles leans back, his voice quieter now. He remembers something his father once said about fortune-tellers, about not wanting to know what comes next. He considers the image on the screen, now just noise, and speaks as if to himself about the weight of knowing what lies ahead.

description: Charles turns off the television and picks up the videotape, noting the return address is from Bucharest. He hands Amy a thick envelope containing plane tickets, hotel reservations, and a per diem. Amy hesitates for a moment, then snatches the envelope. She smiles, caught off guard by Charles's awareness of the city's significance. Charles tells her to be careful. Amy smirks, says nothing, and walks out.
